requiredInputs: exact frame hashes and alpha-geometry hashes
source transfer library built from approved mod-author sources
wear/export contract for the target runtime

geometryLock.allowedAlphaGrowth: ATTACHMENT or HARDWARE only, after explicit edge-fit validation
geometryLock.notes: The hand-edited curved front band, backward slouch mass, contact edge and directional silhouette are locked construction.

band.geometry: lower authored band region; follow source pixels, never flatten the curve

crown.purpose: small body/crown motifs and pattern treatment

rear_slouch.geometry: rear/top mass defined by each authored view

attachment_edge.purpose: pom, label, hardware or other explicitly additive pieces
attachment_edge.geometry: edge anchors only; locked base alpha may not be removed

safeTransferRules: construction template owns alpha/silhouette and direction-specific shape
style donors may change colour/value treatment but never alpha
surface patterns and motifs must land only on declared opaque zones
attachments/hardware may add alpha only at declared attachment edges
all reusable source components require a target semantic zone/anchor
every neutral render must round-trip to the construction template before variation is accepted

incompatibilities.reason: different source geometry must become its own template
base-specific authored delta cannot transfer to PL slouch construction
generic brimless/V5 normalization previously regressed approved geometry
resampling can flatten the hand-edited curved band and slouch silhouette
cross-template parts must map through semantic zones/anchors
